description: This file defines a class for counting tokens in Vertex AI partner models such as Claude and Mistral. It includes methods to determine the publisher for a given model, build the appropriate API endpoint URL, and handle asynchronous requests to obtain token counts from Vertex AI's API.

classes.name: VertexAIPartnerModelsTokenCounter
classes.description: A class for handling token counting for Vertex AI partner models, extending VertexBase, with methods to identify publisher, build API URL, and process token count requests asynchronously.

methods.name: str _get_publisher_for_model(self, model: str)
methods.description: Determines the publisher name based on the model name, e.g., 'anthropic' for Claude models.

methods.name: str _build_count_tokens_endpoint( self, model: str, project_id: str, vertex_location: str, api_base: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Constructs the API endpoint URL for token counting based on model, project ID, location, and optional custom API base.

methods.description: Asynchronously handles a token counting request by validating input, obtaining credentials, constructing the endpoint, making the HTTP request, and returning the token count.
